_comment: Coverage-gate-v2 floor (verbara-meta/ADR-0013). Manual ratchet, no CI write-back (ADR-0003/ADR-0038 D2). Two-sided band on line: fail if measured < line OR measured > line + slack (stale floor -> raise 'line' to floor(measured) in the same PR). 'branch' and 'lines_valid_min' are hard lower bounds; 'patch' is the diff-coverage floor (check-patch-coverage.py). Values honest as of the 2026-10-01 run (same unit subset as build-and-test, coverlet.runsettings): line 78.39%, branch 64.43%, lines-valid 30381. The account-status enforcement and its tests took line from 77.76% on the parent commit across the old 78% band ceiling, so 'line' was raised 75 -> 78 (floor(measured)); band now [78, 81]. Local measurement sits only 0.39 points above 'line': if CI measures under 78, add tests for the new paths rather than lowering the floor. 2026-10-11 (partner-channel-pilot-fixes): measured line 81.16%, branch 69.05%, lines-valid 34112 on the same subset, above the 81% band ceiling, so 'line' was raised 78 -> 81 (floor(measured)); band now [81, 84]. Local measurement sits 0.16 points above 'line'. 2026-10-27 (fix-ip-host-tenant-resolution): measured line 84.01%, branch 72.25%, lines-valid 39682 on the same subset, above the 84% band ceiling, so 'line' was raised 81 -> 84 (floor(measured)); band now [84, 87]. Local measurement sits only 0.01 points above 'line': if CI measures under 84, add tests rather than lowering the floor.
